notablePrerequisites: You control at least three lands.
description:
Cast Brass's Bounty by paying {6}{R}.
Holding priority, activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Brass's Bounty.
Resolve the copy of Brass's Bounty, creating at least three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat from step 2.
If you control at least four lands, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
